arguments.content:
# Linux-only conditional action: bring now-playing track into view when its
# browser folder is already current but the row is off-screen (swipe-up
# browser collapsed).

call ext.nothingness.setSetting name=immersive value=false
call ext.nothingness.setSetting name=browserPresentation value=swipe_up

nav /opt/nothingness/media

# Pick the first fixture file (likely outside the collapsed viewport).
call ext.nothingness.playTrackByPath path=/opt/nothingness/media/01-undercover-49.opus

inspect
shoot before_jump_to_track

# Conditional glyph button should now exist.
call ext.nothingness.tapByKey key=void-crumb-jump-to-playing-track

inspect
shoot after_jump_to_track

overflows
